description: This file defines a set of matchers for comparing elements within slices, including functions for matching all elements, matching with index, and handling options for ignoring extras or missing elements. It also includes the implementation of the ElementsMatcher class and related types.

classes.name: ElementsMatcher
classes.description: A matcher that applies custom matchers to each element of a slice, identified by a mapping function, with options to ignore extra or missing elements.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Checks if the actual value (expected to be a slice) matches the defined element matchers.

methods.name: matchElements
methods.description: Performs the core matching logic, returning errors for mismatches or unexpected elements.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Returns a failure message if the matching fails.

methods.name: NegatedFailureMessage
methods.description: Returns a message for negated matching failure.

methods.name: Failures
methods.description: Returns the list of errors encountered during matching.
